annotations.title: A novelist's books in this corpus, with the genre each one's prose falls in

description:
Every novel by one author in this corpus, in order of year, with the genre its prose places it in and how the author's novels split across genres.

Example questions:
- "What novels did Charles Dickens write?"
- "Which Jane Austen books are covered?"
- "Did Walter Scott write in more than one genre?"
